messages:
deploy-bot: release pause: canary deployment flagged - env-parity-check FAILED between staging and prod. Reason: namespace defaults + secret path normalization.

maria: noted. which keys mismatch?

deploy-bot: diff snippet:
```
# staging
volumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /etc/config
    name: infra-config
# prod
volumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /etc/config/
    name: infra-config
```

alex: ah trailing slash. helm template will render a different path -> init container that copies secrets fails.

jen: also seeing secret key names normalized in prod (no trailing slash) vs staging. iirc chart change last week to sanitize paths.

sam: can we patch chart on staging to match prod quickly? or rollback prod canary?

maria: recommend rollback canary. pin image to `web:v1.9.3` until we normalize chart across envs.

alex: agree. i'll open quick PR to pin image and annotate release notes: "rollback canary due to env parity: path normalization"

jen: i'll prepare chart PR to strip/add trailing slash consistently and add unit test. goal: ship patch in change window at 17:30 PT.

sam: pinned prod canary -> tagging `release/pin-2080012345` and created snapshot.

releasebot: [auto] release pinned by sam. snapshot id: snap-20280321-5501

maria: update to release notes + scheduling in calendar invite. will follow up with postmortem if patch causes layout changes.

alex: :thumbsup:
